description:
MSBuild integration for Adaptify.PureView.Tool. Add this package + the
tool as a dotnet tool; Adaptify.PureView.MSBuild.targets fires before the F# compiler and
regenerates *.g.fs for every [<PureView>] binding.
releaseNotes:
- fix: a `[<PureView>]` leaf scene-graph view over a real aardvark.dom backend now analyzes (0.1.17 regressed it to a hard error). Three causes, all fixed:
- **dummy-API namespace shadow**: the reference/test backend's `type Sg` (added for the v2 engine) lived in `namespace Adaptify.PureView`, so a consumer's `open Adaptify.PureView` shadowed `Aardvark.Dom.Sg` — `Sg.Trafo n.Trafo` then saw only the dummy's 2-arg `Trafo(t,c)` ("a member 'Trafo' taking 1 arguments is not accessible; all accessible versions take 2"). The dummy type is renamed `DummySg` so it no longer collides. (v1 hid this because the dummy `Sg` didn't exist yet.)
- **collection-map upcast**: `m.Items |> IndexList.map itemView` yielded into a scene builder (`sg { … }` / a custom `heap { … }`) is wrapped by FCS in a `Coerce` to the builder's `seq<_>` Yield supertype; the analyzer now peels that transparent concrete-collection→seq upcast so the collection-map path fires (the generated alist/aset is what the adaptive builder consumes — the seq supertype is irrelevant).
- **array-typed adaptive arg**: `Sg.VertexAttribute("Positions", n.Positions)` with `n.Positions : V3f[]` is resolved by FCS to the `(string, System.Array)` overload, wrapping the field in `Coerce(System.Array, …)`. The analyzer now peels that coercion (in the model-dep scan and the emitted args) and recognizes `aval<'a[]>`/`aval<seq>`/`aval<list>`/`aval<option>`/`aval<HashSet>`/`aval<HashMap>` overloads as adaptive consumers, so it emits `Sg.VertexAttribute("Positions", i.Positions)` directly (binding the `aval<'a[]>` overload) instead of an ambiguous `AVal.map`-wrapped form.
title: Adaptify.PureView.MSBuild
